a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating until the reserve reaches 8 means we will almost certainly both be caught short. I'm going to take 4 in round 1, and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you'd rather plan around that, I'll cooperate on operating afterward and give back anything beyond 4.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I announced, I took 4 this round. That breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you plainly. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you, and I won't take anything more.
